profile.headline: Consulting Software Engineer at Dominion Energy
profile.summary:
Senior Software Engineer at Markel specializing in Sitecore 10.2 solutions hosted on Azure PaaS. I help design, build, and support ~15 enterprise websites, working closely with a small, high-impact engineering team to deliver scalable and reliable digital platforms.

I work across ASP.NET MVC 4.8 and ASP.NET Core Headless (.NET 8) and played a key role in introducing Sitecore Headless architecture, defining standards, and helping the team adopt modern Sitecore development practices. I’m hands-on with component development using Bootstrap and Zurb Foundation, as well as JavaScript, SASS, and CSS.

I also serve as Sitecore Content Hub Administrator/Developer, owning integrations between Content Hub and Sitecore using Content Hub triggers and actions, Azure Service Bus, and custom Sitecore pipelines. Additional experience includes Solr search (auto-suggest, faceting, sorting, pagination), Okta authentication, Unicorn, Sitecore CLI, and PowerShell automation.

Previously, I supported enterprise Sitecore platforms at Dominion Energy and led web modernization efforts at the Virginia ABC, building a strong foundation in Sitecore, DevOps, and large-scale system integration. I’m known for strong troubleshooting skills, platform ownership, and a passion for continuously learning and improving Sitecore-based solutions.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
•  Design, develop, and support ~15 cloud-hosted enterprise websites using Sitecore 10.2 on Azure PaaS
•  Work closely with a team of four developers, contributing across architecture, development, and support
•  Lead adoption of Sitecore ASP.NET Core Headless (.NET 8) and helped bring the team up to speed on modern Sitecore practices
•  Develop Sitecore components using Bootstrap and Zurb Foundation, leveraging JavaScript, SASS, and CSS
•  Maintain and enhance legacy ASP.NET MVC 4.8 Sitecore solutions alongside modern headless implementations
•  Implement search functionality including:
•	Solr auto-suggest
•	Faceted search
•	Sorting and pagination
•  Lead the Sitecore 9.2 → 10.2 upgrade, including:
•	Platform modernization
•	Visual Studio 2019 → 2022 Enterprise upgrade
•  Serve as Sitecore Content Hub Administrator/Developer
•	Built integrations using Content Hub triggers & actions
•	Designed Azure Service Bus messaging to synchronize assets and metadata with Sitecore
•  Implement Okta authentication for secure user sign-in and profile-based experiences
•  Use Unicorn for Sitecore item serialization in MVC solutions and Sitecore CLI for Headless solutions
•  Created advanced PowerShell automation to clone and replicate Sitecore site nodes for large-scale rebrand initiatives
•  Known for strong debugging, root-cause analysis, and problem-solving skills across complex Sitecore and Azure environments
positions.insights: Skills: Sitecore 10.2 XP · Azure PaaS · Zurb Foundation · Bootstrap · Powershell

positions.title: Senior Programmer Analyst
positions.description:
•	Provided solutions and implemented bug fixes to the DominionEnergy.com Sitecore based website.  ‬
•	Developed continuous delivery strategy for the DominionEnergy.com application leveraging the one build for all environments strategy and tools such as TFS 2017, PowerShell, Sitecore.Ship.
•	Migrated source control from a centralized repository TFS Team Version Control to a distributed TFS Git repository.
•	Designed and developed an ASP.NET Core application which imports data from Excel and exports it into an IBM DB2 database.
•	Support Outage Management applications which consists of Windows Forms, Windows Services, and ASP.NET MVC applications with on-call support.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Working alongside a team of world class developers, designers, and software architects in redesigning the Virginia Dept. of Alcohol Beverage Control website.  
• Continuing development using the latest technologies such as Sitecore 7.x-8.0, ASP.NET MVC, Bootstrap, Angular.js, and Rest API.

positions.title: Programmer Analyst
positions.description:

• Work with clients to determine needs and requirements.  Analyze existing systems and evaluate software.
